input_fields.name: conical_face
input_fields.description: One face already identified as a conical face.

input_fields.name: angle_convention
input_fields.description: Explicit half-angle or full-angle convention and measurement frame.

input_fields.name: unit
input_fields.description: Requested angular/length unit for the result.

result_fields.name: cone_measurement
result_fields.description: Angle under the declared convention, axis/apex context, trimmed span, unit, and face identity.

procedure: Resolve one conical face and record the angle convention before reading values.
Measure the analytic angle and one declared trimmed span in the requested unit.
Return cone_measurement with half/full-angle label and measurement_status.
Do not silently convert half-angle to full-angle or use an untrimmed extent.
rejection_rules: Reject a nonconical/ambiguous face, missing convention, incompatible unit, or nonfinite span.
Reject a visual angle estimate as analytic measurement.
Do not change the face to make its angle fit.
